package.description: Software GUI for Remote Control of SLS701 Light Source

en-US.description: Software GUI for Remote Control of SLS701 Light Source
en-US.longDescription: The SLS701 software GUI’s controls duplicate most front panel functions, including intensity adjustment, turning the light source on/off, toggling between open-loop and closed-loop operation, and activating/deactivating the ports on the back panel. The software GUI and front panel controls are enabled at the same time. Both constantly read the light source's status and update their displayed information accordingly (e.g. any adjustments made to the light source using the front panel is registered by and used to update the status of the GUI).
en-US.name: SLS701

zh-CN.description: SLS701 光源远程控制软件图形用户界面
zh-CN.longDescription: SLS701 软件图形用户界面的控件复刻了前面板的大部分功能，包括强度调节、光源开关、开环/闭环模式切换以及背板端口激活/禁用功能。软件界面与前面板控制可同步启用，二者会持续读取光源状态并实时更新显示信息（例如通过前面板对光源进行的任何调节都会被系统记录，并同步更新至图形界面的状态显示）。
